meta.name: Acme LED 256 D 10W
meta.description: Acme LED 256 D 10W is a single-unit effect light, probably built as a dome-housed mirror-style effect. It sits on a probably black cylindrical drum base, roughly 0.24 by 0.29 by 0.24 m (dimensions are an assumption, as the tree gives unspecified units). A pan hinge on the base carries a head that tilts on a second hinge, both manually aimed with a full 360-degree range. The round hemispherical dome head is about as wide as it is tall, with a flat, zero-thickness lens disc set into its opening facing outward. The front optic is probably a set of round faceted lens or mirror cells in staggered latitude rows over the upper dome, with a plain black drum below; the exact count is unknown, but roughly two dozen appear in reference images. The DMX mode gives no individually addressable cells, so treat them as one shared group. A parabolic mirror rotation control exists, but no matching node is modelled, so its motion is undetermined. A U-shaped side bracket is probably present on the drum but is not in the tree.
